instructions: Read AGENTS.md first: its generated block holds the shared engineering rules. Do not repeat what CI already enforces (formatters, linters, tests). Prefer few specific high-confidence comments, and say plainly when you found nothing worth flagging. Keep the summary short enough to read in a few seconds (AGENTS.md R24). A doc that contradicts another doc, or a pointer to a file the PR moved, is a real defect.

rules.rule: Documentation changes must not invent facts. If a doc states a number, guarantee, SLO or architectural claim, it should be traceable to something else in the repository or to a named external source. A plausible figure with no basis is worse than an acknowledged gap (AGENTS.md R4: flag gaps, do not fill them). Watch particularly for latency, throughput and savings figures: a number that is not measured does not ship.

When a PR moves, renames or deletes a file, directory or document heading, every inbound reference to the old location must be updated in the same PR. Name the referring files you can see. A stale pointer misleads confidently.

This repository is public. Flag any diff that introduces credentials, API keys or tokens; customer data; personal information; or internal material. Internal material includes links to private nexus-xyz repositories, Linear issue links, internal hostnames and Slack channel names, and text copied from internal docs. Check test fixtures, committed .env files, pasted logs and code comments too.
